_about: RadAnki rules: data only (no code). The built-in copy ships with the extension; a newer copy is read once a day from the radanki_rules GitHub repo. Lists here ADD to the rules built into the code.

sections._comment: keywords: extra words per section (lowercase, whole words or phrases). strong: a phrase that decides the section by itself. physicsOverrides: phrases that make a question Physics. excludeFromPhysics: phrases ignored when deciding Physics (radiation as a cause of disease).

related._comment: genericWords: answers / topics too generic to search for related deck cards.

choicesOnFront._comment: extraTriggers: phrases in the question sentence that put the answer options on the card front.

physicsCurriculum._comment: Order of physics topics for the weekly physics section. Empty = the deck's own tag order.
